notes: PixelQuest folder added with user approval.
Continuous base textures (grass, asphalt, water, paper) are opaque RGBA; isolated sprites and ink overlays have real transparent pixels.
Full-bleed seamless tiles have no padding. West round badges follow 90% diameter rather than generic 8% padding.
Non-square sprites have square 1024px masters with aspect ratio preserved.
Original geometry and original generated illustration, no prior conversation artwork reused.
